name: OSEL Devices Ltd
about: Founded in 2006, Osel Devices Limited manufactures LED display systems and hearing aids.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Divison[1]
A)LED Display System (70% of FY23 revenue)[2]
The company manufactures LED display systems for commercial use, including key components for advertising media, billboards, corporate boardrooms, presentations, display promotions, command centers, and front signs. 
These LED display systems come with an integrated content management system that allows users to connect via phone or computer to manage and display content on the screens.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 39.2%
cons: Stock is trading at 7.71 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -6.32%
Debtor days have increased from 86.3 to 128 days.
Working capital days have increased from 75.9 days to 163 days
